exact_statement: For iid Uniform[1,2] passage times on undirected nearest-neighbour Z^2 and integer n>=1, T(0,n e1) equals the minimum over simple paths of the finite induced graph on [-2n,2n]^2 intersect Z^2; n<=T<=2n.
proof: The direct n-edge path costs at most 2n. More than 2n edges cost more than 2n; leaving the box takes at least 2n+1 edges. Positive loops can be removed. There are finitely many simple paths inside the finite box.
remaining_gap: No variance exponent estimate follows from this finite reduction.
